crossRefs.note: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the…

translations.web: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
translations.bsb: He killed their vines with hailstones and their sycamore-figs with sleet.
translations.kjv: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
translations.asv: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycomore-trees with frost.
